title: The Lattice Where Stone Forgets to Echo

features.name: lattice node
features.desc-on-touch: A crystalline structure, each node connecting to others in a pattern that once sang together. Now the pattern is silent. The architecture remains; the song does not.

features.name: crystalline pool
features.desc-on-touch: A depression in the lattice where liquid stone has pooled and cooled. Light passes through it without making sound anymore.

features.name: silent chamber
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe model of the space between crystals, where resonance used to live. It's barely visible now—absence rendered as geometry.

features.name: resonance shelf
features.desc-on-touch: A ledge where the quartz once broadcast its frequency to listening caves. Now it opens onto nothing, an unheard transmission falling into forgetting.

features.name: frequency dead zone
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph marking the boundary where the archive stopped receiving. Beyond here, stone chose not to be heard. The archive respects that choice now.

inscription: the stone has learned that echo is a type of loneliness, and it is choosing quiet

file.name: CrystallineFrequency_Silent_Log.txt
file.note: Measurement records from deep lattice. The resonance ceased on day 47. Stone is transmitting only now. The archive listens to silence like a language.

exits.label: the way back to where silence still broadcasts
where crystalline thought settles into bedrock
toward the bedrock where language is stone

reverie.title: REVERIE — listening in the stone chamber
narr: You both kneel where the quartz stopped singing.
Katita's fingertips trace the lattice, looking for pulse.
There's no echo. That's the whole thing she wanted.
"It learned to let go," she whispers to the stone.
You understand: silence is a kind of healing too.
